summary: Orangekloud Technology Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, to disclose that its board adopted an Amended and Restated 2025 Equity Incentive Plan on May 8, 2026. The plan increases the maximum shares available from 307,051 to 875,965 Class A ordinary shares and adds Restricted Stock Unit Awards. The company notes it relies on a home-country exemption from Nasdaq shareholder approval rules for equity compensation. This is an ordinary equity incentive plan amendment, not a special situation.
